description: Stage a text source for chronological reading when sequence matters: books, papers, articles, transcripts, or similar texts. The source body is stored in SQLite but NOT returned by this call; encounter it portion by portion with source_read. For a filePath, do not inspect or sample the file first. This is not the graph-native coding workflow: code belongs in ordered document nodes, with generated files used only as executable projections. Accepts content directly or a filePath within UG_SOURCE_ROOT (the server working directory by default).

content.description: Full text content to read through (use filePath instead for large files)

filePath.description: Relative or absolute path to a text file within UG_SOURCE_ROOT (defaults to the server working directory)

title.description: Title of the source (e.g., "Attention Is All You Need")

workflow.description: Purpose for re-entry guidance. Use research when passages serve a live inquiry; otherwise reading.

name: source_load
